result.title: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
result.summary: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view positions, shared box-local embeddings, and object-wise attention. A correspondence loss encourages the editor to attend to matching observations during denoising. We also introduce LayoutLoop, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing benchmark with calibrated layouts and designed revisits. We conduct extensive experiments on LayoutLoop and real-scene data to verify the ability of our method. The project page is at https://ykchizs.github.io/layoutrecall.github.io/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LayoutRecall：在多轮 3D 布局控制的图像编辑中，将物体外观 latent 存于 3D 框面与框局部坐标系，按目标视角射线检索，并以几何对齐条件注入编辑器，配合对应损失训练，同时发布 LayoutLoop 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其几何锚定的 latent 记忆与对应损失可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据检索、注意力对齐与历史观测复用的做法；但工作属图像编辑，未涉及推理状态生成或答案对 latent 的使用，迁移需验证。
